join_google_meet: join a google meet meeting by passing a meet.google.com URL with optional mode and node parameters
speak_in_meeting: send a text message to be spoken aloud in an active google meet session via enqueue_say
get_meeting_transcript: retrieve the last N lines of the live meeting transcript or full meeting status via tool handlers
install_meet_plugin: install google meet plugin dependencies including playwright chromium and audio tools using the install CLI subcommand
register_meet_node: register a remote node in the NodeRegistry and route meet join or say commands to it by name
